newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop shrs up on strong sales response.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop shrs up on strong sales response.

text.p: A strong response to flat sales boosted shares in Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, which rose HK$3.50 or 3.87 percent to hit all time high of HK$94.00 at midday on Monday, brokers said.
Volume was 1.62 million shares worth HK$150.35 million.

"Strong flat sales response of its latest Tuen Mun development boosted demand for the company's shares today," said Sean Li, associate director from Amsteel Securities. "The price surge was also extended to shares of other property developers who have land banks in the area."
"Anticipation the company will achieve stronger flat sales revenue in the current fiscal year also aided buying," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.

A spokeswoman for Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said the group's latest sale of 528 units at the Villa Tiara residential development in Tuen Mun in Hong Kong's New Territories were all sold out during the first day of sales on Saturday.
